metrics.scope: Kernel-visible online logical CPUs, their Linux online scheduling domain and aggregate; not process affinity or cgroup quota entitlement.
metrics.denominator: Exact delta of user+nice+system+idle+iowait+irq+softirq+steal accounting ticks in the actual acquisition-start interval.
metrics.reset_rule: First/demand/topology/reset/zero-time/no-progress/gap is pending; a decrease in any contributing category rebases all CPUs. Unavailable is not zero.
metrics.derivation: linux:execution-ticks-v1. Busy=user+nice+system+irq+softirq; guest subcategories are not counted twice. Preserve exact busy/total delta integers; percent=100*busy/total. Sum all intended CPUs for aggregate/domain, never average percentages.

metrics.scope: OS-visible active logical CPUs, their native Windows processor groups and aggregate; not process affinity or quota entitlement.
metrics.denominator: Exact delta of cumulative user+non-idle privileged+idle OS accounting in the actual acquisition-start interval; not PDH wall time.
metrics.reset_rule: First/demand/topology/reset/zero-time/no-progress/gap is pending; any contributing component decrease rebases all CPUs. Unavailable is not zero.
metrics.derivation: windows:pdh-accounted-time-v1. Busy=delta user+privileged; total=delta user+privileged+idle. Preserve exact integers; percent=100*busy/total, weighted across all intended CPUs. Interrupt/DPC subsets are not added twice. 100-ns units do not claim 100-ns accuracy.
